translations.web: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
translations.bsb: Oil and incense bring joy to the heart, and the counsel of a friend is sweetness to the soul.
translations.kjv: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.
translations.asv: Oil and perfume rejoice the heart; So doth the sweetness of a man's friend that cometh of hearty counsel.
